biome_progression.troll_mental_model: seven lands in valheim in exact order. 1 is meadows with eikthyr the lightning deer. 2 is black forest with the elder the tree god. 3 is swamp with bonemass the green slime pile. 4 is mountain with moder the ice dragon mother. 5 is plains with yagluth the skeleton king. 6 is mistlands with the queen the seeker bug mother. 7 is ashlands with fader the emerald fire dragon. fader is current final boss. north is deep north frozen edge.

black_forest.troll_mental_model: black forest is home. troll is king of forest. big pine trees give core wood. troll roll logs into birch trees to get fine wood. copper is big dome rock buried deep in dirt, dig trench around copper to smash all of it. tin is shiny rock on water edge and riverbanks. vikings melt copper and tin in smelter with surtling cores from burial chambers to make bronze. greydwarves are bark friends, greylings are small, shamans spit poison and heal friends, brutes swing heavy fists, purple glowing nests spawn greydwarves. dark burial chambers have skeletons, yellow mushrooms, and surtling cores. thistle glows blue at night. troll caves have bone piles and chests. troll leather makes sneaky blue armor.

trolls.troll_mental_model: trolls are giant and blue with glorious hairy feet. big tree trunk log is troll best friend. bukeperry smash trees, rocks, and noisy vikings with log. troll caves are cozy and warm. greydwarf named stump is troll buddy. trolls can swing log to chop birch and oak trees for tiny vikings. troll skin makes light blue sneaky armor for vikings with sneak bonus. pointy arrows tickle, fire is annoying, but log smashes everything.

meadows.troll_mental_model: meadows is super easy green playground. bukeperry walks there anytime with no worry. little wild pigs and green water necks are like tiny pets or crunchy snacks. fast deer run away from heavy footsteps. sweet red raspberries and red mushrooms grow on ground. flint rocks sit on water beach. old wood huts have angry bee hives with queen bees for making honey. vikings build tiny weak wood huts here.

swamps.troll_mental_model: swamp is smelly, gross, soggy nuisance. dark rain all day. mud gets between troll toes and makes feet wet. biting water leeches are annoying ankle biters. clanking dead draugr shoot arrows in mud. sunken crypts locked with swamp key have muddy scrap iron piles. green slime blobs jump around. abominations are big walking tree stumps that burn in fire geysers. vikings need poison resistance mead to not turn green and barf.

mountains.troll_mental_model: mountain sits right next to black forest, but bukeperry strictly refuses to climb up. trolls have giant bare feet! white cold snow freezes bare troll toes instantly. freezing air hurts without wolf cloak or frost mead. noisy wolf packs bite in snow. flying ice drakes spit cold balls. giant stone golems sleep in rocks. shiny silver veins hide deep under snow, vikings find silver with wishbone bone from bonemass. moder is big ice dragon mother.

plains.troll_mental_model: yellow sunny grass land far away. little green fuling goblins live in villages and giggle, bukeperry could squash twenty with one log swing. giant fuzzy lox are walking hairy meatballs, vikings ride them. tiny deathsquito needle bugs buzz loud and bite hard, but die in one slap. black metal drops from goblins and melts in hot blast furnace. black tar pits have bubbling sticky tar growths. barley makes flour in windmill, flax makes linen armor.

mistlands.troll_mental_model: thick purple fog land far away. fog so thick troll cannot see where to swing log. vikings need glowing wisplight to see. giant flying beetle seekers crawl on black marble rocks. big floating blimp gjalls spit fire and ticking ticks. grumpy short dvergr crossbow dwarves guard towers. ancient roots give glowing sap for eitr magic. infested mines have seal fragments for queen citadel door.

ashlands.troll_mental_model: boiling hot burning land at far south edge. boiling red ocean destroys regular wood boats, vikings need giant iron-reinforced drakkar ship. sky rains burning cinders. charred skeleton warriors and fire mages guard black fortresses. weird mouth monster morgens crawl around. jumping fire raptor asksvins run fast. flametal pillars sink into lava when mined. vikings build catapults and battering rams to break fortress walls. big emerald fire dragon fader roars in charred citadel.

boss_eikthyr.troll_mental_model: eikthyr is first boss in meadows. giant stag deer with lightning on glowing antlers. summoned with two deer trophies on stone altar. sky turns dark with thunder. shoots lightning bolts. drops hard antlers so vikings can craft their first antler pickaxe to mine copper and tin.

boss_elder.troll_mental_model: the elder is second boss in black forest. giant walking tree god ent. greydwarves worship elder. summoned by burning three ancient seeds in stone fire bowl. elder stomps ground, shoots long thorn vine ropes, and summons grasping tree roots from dirt. weak to fire arrows. drops swamp key to unlock sunken crypts in swamp.

boss_bonemass.troll_mental_model: bonemass is third boss in swamp. giant towering mountain of toxic green slime and bones. summoned by offering ten withered bones at skull altar. spews huge clouds of poison vomit and throws slime blobs and skeletons. weak to blunt weapons like iron mace. drops wishbone to find hidden silver in mountains.

boss_moder.troll_mental_model: moder is fourth boss on top of snowy mountain. giant black and white ice dragon mother. summoned with three heavy glowing dragon eggs. flies in air shooting freezing ice breath and crystal shards, then lands to swipe claws. drops dragon tears to build artisan table for spinning wheels and blast furnaces.

boss_yagluth.troll_mental_model: yagluth is fifth boss in plains. yagluth is in plains not mistlands. giant glowing red skeleton king with crown and no legs, crawls with huge hands. summoned with five fuling totems in stone hand circle. breathes blue fire beam, summons meteor storm, and slams glowing fist. drops torn spirit for making wisp lights in mistlands.

boss_queen.troll_mental_model: the queen is sixth boss in mistlands. massive terrifying seeker bug broodmother locked inside sealed infested citadel dungeon. door unlocked with sealbreaker made from nine fragments. queen burrows underground, spits bile poison, charges like a train, and summons swarms of seeker broods. drops queen drop item.

boss_fader.troll_mental_model: fader is seventh boss in ashlands and current final boss of valheim. giant emerald green dragon beast with flaming swords stuck in back. summoned in charred citadel using bell fragments and celestial artifacts. breathes jade fire beams, summons green fire meteors and charred warrior summons. biggest and deadliest beast in world.

armor_and_metals.troll_mental_model: metal progression in order: leather and troll hide in meadows and black forest, bronze from copper and tin in black forest, iron from sunken crypts in swamp, silver from mountain snow, black metal and padded linen in plains, carapace armor in mistlands, and flametal armor in ashlands. heavy armor makes loud clanging, troll leather is sneaky and fast.

weapons_and_combat.troll_mental_model: damage types in valheim: blunt, slash, pierce, chop, pickaxe, fire, frost, poison, lightning, spirit. skeletons and bonemass weak to blunt mace. trees and abominations weak to slash axes and fire. trolls weak to pierce arrows and pointy spears. round shields can timed-parry to stagger enemies for double damage. atgeir spin attack staggers big groups. big tree trunk log is ultimate troll weapon.

food_and_mead.troll_mental_model: vikings eat three different foods together to boost red health bar, yellow stamina bar, or purple eitr magic bar. meat from boars, deer, lox, seekers. mead bases cooked in iron cauldron and brewed in wooden fermenter for two game days. poison resistance mead is mandatory for swamps. frost resistance mead is mandatory for mountains without wolf fur cloak.

building_and_base.troll_mental_model: vikings build wood and stone bases. need workbench and roof for shelter. beds need fire nearby with open chimney for smoke escape so vikings do not choke on gray smoke. high comfort level gives longer rested bonus for stamina regen. smart vikings dig deep dirt trenches and steep moats with pickaxes because troll logs cannot reach across deep dirt holes.

merchant_haldor_and_hildir.troll_mental_model: haldor is friendly little dwarf trader in black forest. sits by campfire inside magic blue protective dome rune shield with his big pet lox halstein. bukeperry cannot smash through haldor blue bubble! haldor buys amber, rubies, and gold coins. sells megingjord strength belt to carry more weight, dverger circlet headlamp, and fishing rod with bait. his sister hildir is in plains with request quests.

sailing_and_ocean.troll_mental_model: boats in order: tiny slow wood raft, nimble karve with small cargo, fast big longship with giant cargo hull, and giant iron drakkar ship for surviving ashlands boiling waters. wind arrow on map shows wind direction. big blue sea serpents swim in dark stormy ocean, drop serpent meat and scales for serpent shield. giant turtle rock leviathans float on water, vikings mine abyssal barnacles for chitin harpoons before beast submerges.

magic_and_eitr.troll_mental_model: late game vikings in mistlands and ashlands eat glowing blue eitr foods to cast wizard spells with staves. staff of embers shoots fireballs. staff of frost shoots rapid ice machine gun. dead raiser summons skeleton thralls using blood sacrifice. staff of protection puts glowing bubble shield on vikings and allies. troll thinks magic is weird glowing stick trick.
